card.name: Commas inside symptom lists
card.fires_on: The comma after a symptom (such as vomiting or excessive thirst) in a list of signs and symptoms, and the word include that introduces such a list. Mostly seen in metabolic acidosis and hyperglycemia warnings.

modes.label: Comma after listed symptom
modes.description: A comma following a symptom inside a list of signs of acidosis or high blood sugar.
modes.example: include nausea, vomiting<<,>> abdominal pain, generalized malaise, and

modes.label: Word introducing symptom list
modes.description: The word include just before the list of symptoms.
modes.example: reduced caloric intake, ketogenic diet, surgery, volume depletion, and alcohol abuse. Signs and symptoms are consistent with dehydration and severe metabolic acidosis and<< include>> nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, generalized
